item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 08/Jan/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will bring generally fine weather to the coast of Guangdong today and tomorrow. Temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large over inland areas. The monsoon will moderate slightly early next week. It will be cloudier over the coast of southern China. The replenishment of the northeast monsoon is expected to bring cool and dry weather to the coast of southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week.
